meaning:
Someone descended from Meholath(?), first mentioned at 1Sa.18.19
§ Meholathite = Mehola "of dancing"
1) an inhabitant of a place evidently named 'Meholah'
1a) ascribed to Adriel and Barzillai

elsewhere.note: But at the time when Merab, Saul’s daughter, should have been given to David, she was given to Adriel the Meholathite as wife.
